baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَظَرَ at word 2 in the sequential construction ثُمَّ نَظَرَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verb directs sight or insight toward an unstated object, while ثُمَّ isolates that direction as a deliberate phase rather than an incidental glance.

activation_trace.role: Directing sight or insight supplies intentional apprehension and makes the short clause a discrete act of appraisal.

changed_reading.after: Then he deliberately directed sight or thought toward the unstated matter as a distinct act of appraisal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The combination of ثُمَّ with the intransitive-looking نَظَرَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The waiting and respite branch lets the clause hold open an interval: the subject watches for a moment or delays before whatever follows.

activation_trace.role: Watching for a time or granting delay supplies a tactical pause, with ثُمَّ marking its temporal boundary.

changed_reading.before: The clause reports a visual glance.
changed_reading.after: The clause may also stage a suspended beat in which he watches, waits, or withholds his next move.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَظَرَ with no expressed object, leaving the content of its mental inspection open.
baseline_models.mechanism: The counterpart branch activates comparison as a possible operation inside the gaze: alternatives can be set opposite one another and tested for fit.

activation_trace.role: Matching counterpart with counterpart supplies an exploratory comparative operation within the otherwise objectless inspection.

changed_reading.after: He may have mentally set possible counterparts or formulations against each other to see which one would hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prior inner deliberation and measured planning turn the gaze from first discovery into a review pass over an already fashioned judgment.

activation_trace.role: Directed sight or insight provides the later act of checking what has already been mentally formed.
The heart's oscillation over a thing supplies unresolved internal deliberation before the gaze.
Planning by estimation and النظر supplies a designed judgment that the focus gaze can audit or rehearse.

structural_cues: 74:18-21 orders فَكَّرَ, قَدَّرَ, the doubled denunciation of that تقدير, and only then نَظَرَ.
The object of نَظَرَ remains unstated, so the previously planned matter can persist as its discourse object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inner deliberation, repeated estimation, and a later gaze; I infer that the gaze audits or rehearses the drafted judgment. A live alternative is a literal outward glance with no review function.

changed_reading.before: He looks in order to begin forming an opinion.
changed_reading.after: Having already thought and engineered a judgment, he looks again to test, verify, or stage what he has devised.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following face, back, and self-magnification sequence makes the gaze a hinge where private appraisal becomes visible resistance and then bodily withdrawal.

activation_trace.role: Directed apprehension supplies the inward-facing appraisal that is about to become externally legible.
The face's contraction from distress or anger supplies the first visible registration of the appraisal.
Severe facial dislike sharpens the visible reaction from a passing expression into aversion.
Turning the back converts facial aversion into spatial disengagement from what was faced.
Greatness and pride supply the self-elevating posture that governs the withdrawal.

structural_cues: ثُمَّ opens 74:21, 74:22, and 74:23, segmenting gaze, facial contraction, and bodily withdrawal into successive stages.
The progression moves across perceptual, facial, spatial, and status registers without changing the local subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered gaze, facial contraction, turning away, and pride; I infer a disclosure chain in which appraisal becomes embodied refusal. Chronological succession without causation remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The look is a self-contained act of observation.
changed_reading.after: The look is the transition point where an internal judgment leaks onto the face and is completed as proud bodily withdrawal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The gaze becomes a pre-speech editing stage: perception is converted into a compact, repeatable counter-label that can circulate socially.

activation_trace.role: Directed inspection supplies the evidentiary or performative input from which a verbal verdict is fashioned.
Producing speech by utterance externalizes the result of the silent looking sequence.
Diversion and deception provide the dismissive category chosen for the spoken verdict.
Transmission until a report becomes received lore makes the label portable rather than merely private.

structural_cues: After gaze, facial reaction, and withdrawal, 74:24 begins فَقَالَ and supplies a short public formula.
The formula joins a deceptive category to an image of transmission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies silent inspection followed by utterance, a deception label, and transmission; I infer that the gaze helps manufacture a socially usable verdict. The alternative is that he sincerely reports a conclusion reached without rhetorical editing.

changed_reading.before: He looks and later happens to speak.
changed_reading.after: His looking is the silent production phase in which an encounter is recoded into a transmissible hostile explanation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later certainty, doubt, and counterpart language sharpen the exploratory comparison baseline: looking is a branching test in which the same sign can settle knowledge or be forced into a resistant analogy.

activation_trace.role: Matching counterpart with counterpart supplies the comparison operation available within the focus gaze.
Stable knowledge after doubt supplies one possible endpoint of examining the presented sign.
Agitated doubt supplies the competing endpoint in which examination does not settle.
Likeness and counterpart directly activate the focus branch's operation of matching one candidate to another.

structural_cues: Within 74:31, one presented count yields certainty, increased faith, absence of doubt, or a skeptical question about a mathal.
Those opposed outcomes make reception, not mere availability of evidence, the differentiating process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed epistemic outcomes and explicit counterpart language; I project that later fork backward onto the focus gaze as a test of fit. The live alternative is that these outcomes concern only the later number and do not specify the earlier looking.

changed_reading.before: He examines an object whose meaning is simply there to be seen.
changed_reading.after: His gaze is an epistemic fork: comparison can stabilize knowledge, but motivated matching can also process the same encounter into doubt and rejection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later reminder-to-flight sequence recasts the focus gaze as momentary facing: the subject first comes into visual relation with what confronts him, then converts exposure into increasing distance.

activation_trace.role: Facing so that things see one another supplies a reciprocal spatial encounter rather than detached observation.
A reminder that actively recalls supplies the confronting content from which the later audience withdraws.
Turning one's side away supplies the first spatial conversion of encounter into evasion.
Drawing away and increasing distance intensifies mere side-turning into active recoil.
Flight and escape complete the spatial mechanism by maximizing distance from the encounter.

structural_cues: 74:49-51 escalates from turning aside from the reminder to recoil and outright flight.
The later actors are plural, so the sequence is a behavioral analogue rather than simple coreference with the singular subject of 74:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later escalation from reminder through side-turning to flight; I infer that the earlier gaze is the brief facing that makes evasion possible. The alternative is that the later crowd scene has no backward bearing on this individual's look.

changed_reading.before: Looking indicates engagement with what is seen.
changed_reading.after: The look may be only the compulsory moment of facing before attention is reorganized into recoil, distance, and escape.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links a human sequence to distant cosmic oath imagery through repeated أَدْبَرَ. It remains anchored in the focus branch of appearance and in packet-backed withdrawal and uncovering, but downstream prose must present it only as a structural echo, never as identity of subjects or a lexical equation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The appearance-to-a-viewer branch of نَظَرَ, set between the man's later withdrawal and the night/dawn disclosure pair.

activation_trace.role: What appears to a viewer supplies disclosure as the visual event at issue in the focus.
The man's turning of his back supplies an attempted cancellation of visual and relational exposure.
The night also turning away repeats the spatial verb in a cosmic register and reverses its effect.
Removing a cover supplies the disclosure that follows the night's retreat despite the earlier human retreat.

changed_reading.before: He sees and then successfully ends the encounter by turning away.
changed_reading.after: His look belongs to an encounter whose disclosure cannot be canceled by retreat: human withdrawal is later echoed by a cosmic withdrawal that instead uncovers light.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a verbal act of looking is activated by the root's pallor/defect branch and later skin-color imagery. It remains anchored because that branch explicitly concerns a look's visible trace and the next clauses alter the face, but it should be rendered as a somatic echo, not as the lexical claim that نَظَرَ means 'turned pale.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَظَرَ activated through the branch in which a look leaves a mark in color or defect.

activation_trace.role: A look's mark in pallor or defect supplies the possibility that the gaze registers visibly on the subject.
Facial contraction supplies the immediate surface on which the prior looking becomes legible.
Severe facial dislike reinforces visible alteration rather than leaving the appraisal private.
Heat's trace in changed color supplies a later, harsher analogue of appraisal becoming a surface mark.
The appearing skin or surface supplies the material plane on which that later mark is read.

changed_reading.before: The gaze is a private cognitive act.
changed_reading.after: The gaze is also a surface event: inner resistance immediately writes itself onto the face and is later echoed by color-altering exposure of the skin.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the subject grammatically remains the man, while the cited focus branch describes fate's look striking people with ruin. It remains worth carrying because doubled killing language brackets the focus and fiery encounter follows, but prose must not reassign the verb's subject; it may speak only of his gaze being framed under an answering ruinous gaze.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The fate-like destructive-look branch of the focus root, retained without altering the grammatical subject of نَظَرَ.

activation_trace.role: Fate's look that strikes with ruin supplies a destructive counter-gaze around the man's own act of looking.
Putting to death supplies the repeated ruin formula immediately before the focus.
Encountering fire and its heat supplies the later realization of the ruin that frames his gaze.

changed_reading.before: Only the man exercises visual agency when he looks.
changed_reading.after: His look can be heard inside a reciprocal field of exposure: as he looks to judge, the sequence already frames him as seen by a ruin-bearing fate.

strongest_changes: Prior فَكَّرَ and قَدَّرَ make the gaze a review of an already engineered judgment rather than first perception.
The immediate face, back, and pride sequence makes the gaze the hinge from private appraisal to embodied refusal.
Later certainty/doubt and reminder/flight sequences expose looking as both an epistemic fork and a moment of facing before evasion.
summary.what_was_special: The one-word focus sustained visual, temporal, comparative, somatic, and destructive branches; repeated ثُمَّ and later spatial reversals made the brief gaze function as process, posture, and exposure without forcing those readings into one model.
remaining_uncertainties: The object of نَظَرَ is omitted, so the target of inspection and the balance between ocular and mental looking remain open.
Causal arrows from the gaze to facial, verbal, and postural consequences are inferred from sequence rather than explicitly stated.
The cosmic, surface, and ruinous-gaze outliers are branch-backed echoes and should not be promoted into lexical glosses.
